name: What is the best flooring material for a bathroom?

mainEntity.name: What is the best flooring material for a bathroom?

acceptedAnswer.text: Porcelain or ceramic tile and luxury vinyl plank (LVP) are generally the best choices for bathroom floors because of their moisture resistance. Tile provides a permanent, completely waterproof surface that handles standing water and humidity without warping, though it feels colder underfoot and requires proper subfloor preparation. LVP offers a softer, warmer feel and is budget-friendly, but seams must be carefully protected from heavy standing water around tubs and showers. Natural stone is another option, though it requires routine sealing to prevent moisture damage and staining.
acceptedAnswer.description: Porcelain tile and luxury vinyl plank are the top options. Tile offers permanent waterproofing, while luxury vinyl provides a warmer feel and quicker installation.
